method: Official operator websites only (no maps, review sites, listings, blogs or news). Automated fetches first; sites that refused them were read in a browser (marked browserChecked). Bot-check pages were not bypassed. A fetch failure is never treated as a closure.

confirmed.name: Tower of London
confirmed.operatingEvidence: The visit page sells tickets, shows opening times for the day (15 October: 09:00-17:30, last entry 16:30, last Yeoman Warder tour 15:15) and lists dated Opening Ceremony experiences until 1 November 2026. It asks visitors to check temporary route closures.
confirmed.weekly: published one day at a time (15 October: 09:00-17:30)

confirmed.name: Tower Bridge
confirmed.sourceType: operator's own site (City of London Corporation)
confirmed.address: Tower Bridge; entrance on the north-west side of the bridge
confirmed.operatingEvidence: Open daily with tickets on sale; annual closures 24-26 December. A relaxed opening runs on the second Saturday of each month, 09:30-11:30.

confirmed.name: Westminster Abbey
confirmed.address: Westminster Abbey, Dean's Yard, London SW1P 3PA
confirmed.operatingEvidence: Sightseeing hours are published (a working church that can close at short notice); the opening-times page shows a date-specific admittance window and closed areas.
confirmed.caveat: No sightseeing on Sundays; Christmas dates not yet published.

confirmed.name: National Gallery
confirmed.operatingEvidence: Daily hours and the current 'Renoir and Love' exhibition are listed; several rooms are closed for building work (floorplan lists Rooms 1, 7, 8, 16, 17, 17a, 30, 31 and the Sunley Room).

confirmed.name: Tate Modern
confirmed.operatingEvidence: Current exhibitions into 2027 are listed; the Level 0 cloakroom has closed and bags larger than 55x40x20 cm are not allowed.
confirmed.caveat: Christmas dates not on the page read.

confirmed.name: St Paul's Cathedral
confirmed.operatingEvidence: Sightseeing tickets are on sale Monday to Saturday; times can change for services and events, and large bags are not allowed.

confirmed.name: V&A South Kensington
confirmed.operatingEvidence: Current and upcoming exhibitions are listed (Rising Voices to January 2027; Constantinople to Istanbul from 7 November 2026); closed 24-26 December.

confirmed.name: Natural History Museum
confirmed.operatingEvidence: Daily hours, free entry with optional guaranteed-entry tickets, current exhibitions, and closures on 24-26 December.

confirmed.name: Science Museum
confirmed.operatingEvidence: Free pre-booked tickets required; dated autumn closures including all day on 11 November 2026; some galleries closed for building work.

confirmed.name: Sky Garden
confirmed.operatingEvidence: Free timed tickets (released each Monday, three weeks ahead); capacity is temporarily reduced while one lift is out of service; a dated list of hire and maintenance closures for October-December 2026.
confirmed.caveat: Book a free timed ticket; arriving more than 15 minutes late may mean no entry; ID rules apply.

confirmed.name: Leadenhall Market
confirmed.sourceType: operator's own site (City of London Corporation)
confirmed.operatingEvidence: The public areas 'remain open 24/7'; 2026 seasonal events are listed.

confirmed.name: Covent Garden (Market Building and Piazza)
confirmed.address: Covent Garden Piazza, near Covent Garden station (no postal address published)
confirmed.operatingEvidence: The Piazza and Market Building are always open; usual shop hours and current events (lights switch-on 12 November) are published.
confirmed.weekly: always open; shops usually Monday-Saturday 10:00-20:00, Sunday 11:00-18:00

confirmed.name: Borough Market
confirmed.operatingEvidence: Regular trading hours (closed Mondays) and dated festive hours from 30 November 2026 to 2 January 2027.

confirmed.name: Dishoom (Covent Garden)
confirmed.address: 12 Upper St Martin's Lane, London WC2H 9FB
confirmed.operatingEvidence: Open all day, every day for breakfast, lunch and dinner; bookings for any group by day but only for 6 or more after 6 PM.

confirmed.name: The Barbary (Neal's Yard)
confirmed.operatingEvidence: Live booking widget for 2-4 people and walk-ins at the counter; hours are not shown in readable text.

confirmed.name: Rules
confirmed.operatingEvidence: 'Open seven days each week from 2nd March 2026' with a live booking link. No shorts or sportswear; children under 10 not admitted after 7 PM.
confirmed.weekly: daily from 12:00 (last reservation 22:00 Sun-Thu; last orders 23:30 Fri-Sat)

confirmed.name: Afternoon Tea at Claridge's
confirmed.operatingEvidence: Served in the Foyer and Reading Room with a live booking link; a Festive Afternoon Tea replaces it from 3 November to 3 January (not 25 December). Sitting times are not published.

confirmed.name: Core by Clare Smyth
confirmed.operatingEvidence: Current priced menus and an online reservation link; the whole table orders the same format.

confirmed.name: Padella (Borough Market)

confirmed.name: Flat Iron (Covent Garden)

confirmed.operatingEvidence: A menu dated October 2026 and 'a no reservation policy'; Sunday hours are not published.
